newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Feb 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Feb 6.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company

Dispatches, a television programme due to be broadcast tonight, exposes the dealings of a Sotheby expert in Milan. Today, 24 hours before the broadcast, Sotheby's acted by suspending senior members of staff amid claims they illegally smuggled art treasures to London.

Sir Gerald Elliott, former chairman of Christian Salvesen, has increased pressure on the haulage firm by scouring city institutions for backing for his move to oust the company's chief executive Chris Masters and chairman Sir Alick Rankin.
-- GERMANY SINGS PRAISE OF SOARING DOLLAR
Gunter Rexrodt, the German economics minister, has hinted that the G7 meeting this weekend in Berlin will do nothing to prevent the dollar's rise against the Japanese yen.
